example.title: Stauffer Road Bridge (Bridge No. F26-06), Stauffer Road over Israel Creek

brief: Single-span, four-panel riveted steel Pratt full-slope pony truss of about 1930, 62 ft 10 in long with a 13 ft roadway: two 16 ft end panels and two 15 ft interior panels, wide solid rolled chords and end posts, latticed main ties and slim paired-rod counters, steel floor beams and stringers under a thin reinforced-concrete deck. Latticed handrails with latticed intermediate posts run inside the trusses; concrete abutments with stone wingwalls, badly spalled. Stands in open, flat dairy country on a narrow two-lane farm road, with barns and a row of concrete silos in the distance and a curve-warning sign on the approach.
